A study of the Minnesota River is measuring the amount of Nitrogen in mg/L. Historical records suggest that the average quantity is 4.19 mg/L. To conduct their study, they take 40 water samples from randomly determined locations from the river. 

1. What is the population of interest?
2. What is the observational unit?
3. What is the sample?
4. Why is it important that the sample locations were randomized.

Some samples were taken in slow moving portions of the river and other samples were taken in fast moving portions of the river.
